classified_object.notes: Classical competitive chess; online platforms are secondary products.

performance_agency.summary: Outcomes depend on human cognitive performance under time controls.

performance_interface.summary: Motor expression is minimal; embodiment is not the primary performance channel.

embodied_performance.summary: Motor expression is minimal; embodiment is not the primary performance channel. Migrated as Embodied Performance; demand types are provisional.

arena.summary: Discrete board state is rule-bearing; may be physical or digital.

distributed_arena_relation.calibration_equivalence: Time control and platform conditions are deployment-specific.
distributed_arena_relation.safety_relation: Not material to category classification in this record.

sensing_tracking.summary: Full state observability in standard play; platforms add logging and anti-cheat.

measurement.summary: Ratings, results, and pairings provide formal metrics.

comparability.summary: Rating systems and standardized time controls support comparison.

officiation.summary: Arbiters over the board; platform enforcement online.

outcome_openness.summary: Result determined by play unless integrity fails.

consequence_structure.summary: Rating, title, and elimination consequences; bodily exertion not required.

operational_spatial_integration.summary: Digital boards represent a discrete state machine; not operational athletic-spatial integration.

human_limits_accessibility.note: Cognitive fatigue; accessibility differs from contact sport.

source_provisional_finding.summary: Forces separation of sport recognition from embodiment and from Spatial Sport.

content: Altis adopts embodiment as necessary for all sport.
A chess variant where continuous tracked bodily movement in computational space is the performance channel.

evidence_sources.source_title: Certificate of recognition of FIDE by IOC
